name: stable-world
description: The physics half of ledger row #15, executed: the desired world as the STABLE SOLUTION of a fixed law. choice-lang compiled Choice into controlled branching and kept the marked world stable by construction (engineered programs, charge conserved — the language layer); what the ledger kept open was stability as physics. This repo is that law: a fixed dissipative channel (amplitude damping into the world bit, identity on the cargo) whose absorbing class is the marked world — quiet on what is already inside (deviation 0), globally attractive from anywhere (leakage (1-gamma)^k (1-p0) exact for every input), robust under law-error (asymptotic leakage <= eps/(1-(1-eps)(1-gamma)), exact bound + census), escape exactly impossible (the charge is monotone — the world is absorbing, not metastable). The membership charge becomes the law's LYAPUNOV function (increment gamma(1-V) exact; conserved exactly under engineered branch programs — one functional, two regimes, the discrete-Noether shape noted not claimed). The stability is PURCHASED: sector erasure pays h2(q) kT ln2 per run on the classical face (the settled #11 schedule, quoted from route-price), coherent face model-dependent and unpriced. The law selects the WORLD, never the CONTENTS (path-dependent). Boundaries honest: the law is authored (nature's instantiation not claimed), the thermal reading of escape not shipped. The checker enforces the board laws; the renderer refuses illegal boards.
